name: meeting-notes-start
description: Start notes for this live call when the caller explicitly asks you to take notes or minutes, or to send a recap of this call afterwards. Works with no agenda. Voice-only. Minutes are written when the call ends. With recap true, the recap of this call goes to the principal after the call: do not also hand it off with async-offramp or delegate. Calling it again with recap true adds the recap.

inputs.recap: boolean (required — true if the caller asked for a recap or summary of this call after it ends; false for notes or minutes only)

outputs.notes_on: boolean (true once the call is marked for minutes)
outputs.recap: boolean (true when a recap of this call will be sent)
